reason: The hypothesis directly restates the reported 12-electron ethanol oxidation result from P1 as a prediction, and its mechanism—isolated Pt sites suppressing CO poisoning via electronic modulation—is taken almost verbatim from P3, P6, and P14, which already describe this exact concept for methanol oxidation on similar HEAs. The proposed intervention (thermal annealing to induce Pt segregation) is a standard method, and the overall idea merely applies a known mechanism to the specific alloy from P1 without combining findings from different papers or introducing a new mechanistic link.
copied_elements: isolated Pt sites dilute Pt-Pt ensembles and suppress CO poisoning (P3, P6, P14)
electronic modulation of Pt by neighboring atoms tunes d-band center and intermediate adsorption (P3, P6, P32)
contiguous Pt ensembles promote CO binding and 4-electron pathway (P3, P14)
